steps.en: Deploy Tale and configure model credentials and agent capacity
steps.zh: 部署 Tale，配置模型凭证和 agent 容量

steps.en: Add task inputs, choose the project agent and reviewer, and start the task
steps.zh: 填写任务输入，选择项目 agent 与审核人并启动

steps.en: Provide task context to the selected runtime in the agent's persistent workspace
steps.zh: 在 agent 的持久工作目录中向所选运行程序提供任务上下文

steps.en: Attach the agent's report and produced files to the task for review
steps.zh: 把 agent 报告和生成的文件挂回任务，等待审核

steps.en: Inspect the deliverables and accept the result or request changes
steps.zh: 检查交付物，接受结果或要求修改

value.en: The brief, agent output, and review decision remain together on one task
value.zh: 需求、agent 产物与审核决定保留在同一任务里

sources: https://docs.tale.dev/self-hosted/install/quickstart (read 2026-10-08): Docker/Compose startup, owner account, model provider credentials
https://docs.tale.dev/platform/projects/task-automation (read 2026-10-08): choose Assignee and Reviewer, Start agent, report comment and deliverables, accept or request changes
https://docs.tale.dev/platform/agents/harnesses (read 2026-10-08): runtime ownership and persistent agent workspaces
